records.title: Grokked Transformers are Implicit Reasoners: A Mechanistic Journey to the Edge of Generalization
records.reason: This mechanistic study shows transformers learn implicit composition and comparison reasoning only after grokking-length training; a capability/interpretability finding with no inference-system content.

records.title: Diffusion Models and Representation Learning: A Survey
records.reason: This survey reviews diffusion models through the lens of representation learning, covering denoising architectures and guidance; a vision generative-modeling survey unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Grokking of Implicit Reasoning in Transformers: A Mechanistic Journey to the Edge of Generalization
records.reason: The proceedings version of the grokking study on implicit reasoning in transformers, analyzing composition and comparison generalization after extended training; a capability study with no inference contribution.

records.title: Improving Retrieval Augmented Language Model with Self-Reasoning
records.reason: Self-reasoning retrieval-augmented language models generate their own relevance and traceability judgments during inference to filter irrelevant documents; inference-time RAG behavior, but aimed at answer reliability rather than inference efficiency or serving, so borderline.

records.title: Dynamic Neural Network Structure: A Review for its Theories and Applications
records.reason: This TNNLS review systematizes dynamic neural network structures that adapt architecture or parameters per input, including efficiency motivations; a broad review across domains without a specific LLM inference mechanism, hence borderline.

records.title: MTR-DuplexBench: Towards a Comprehensive Evaluation of Multi-Round Conversations for Full-Duplex Speech Language Models
records.reason: MTR-DuplexBench evaluates multi-round conversation handling in full-duplex speech language models, including context consistency during inference; a benchmark contribution, not an inference system.

records.title: A Survey of Graph Transformers: Architectures, Theories and Applications
records.reason: This survey organizes graph transformer architectures, theory and applications for graph-structured data; a GNN-domain survey with no LLM inference-system relevance.

records.title: Generating music with sentiment using Transformer-GANs
records.reason: Transformer-GANs generate sentiment-conditioned music with long-term coherence; a music generation application with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: ORBIT: Oak Ridge Base Foundation Model for Earth System Predictability
records.reason: Title explicitly presents a foundation model for Earth system predictability, a geoscience forecasting application, with no LLM inference subject stated in the title.

records.title: VQToken: Neural Discrete Token Representation Learning for Extreme Token Reduction in Video Large Language Models
records.reason: VQToken learns discrete token representations enabling extreme visual token reduction for video LLMs, directly cutting the sequence length and compute that dominate video-LLM inference; a concrete token-compression contribution to inference efficiency.

records.title: Graph Reasoning Transformer for Image Parsing
records.reason: GReaT uses graph reasoning over image patches for image parsing, restructuring patch interactions in a vision transformer; a computer-vision architecture with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Automated Disentangled Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models
records.reason: This ACM paper applies LLMs to disentangled sequential recommendation, predicting next items from user behavior sequences; a recommender-system application, not an inference-system contribution.

records.title: AceSearcher: Bootstrapping Reasoning and Search for LLMs via Reinforced Self-Play
records.reason: AceSearcher trains one LLM via supervised and reinforcement fine-tuning to alternate between query decomposition and answer solving roles; a training framework for search capability, not inference efficiency.

records.title: When Parts Are Greater Than Sums: Individual LLM Components Can Outperform Full Models
records.reason: Decomposing LLM outputs into attention-head and MLP contributions shows individual components can beat the full model on classification; an in-context-learning analysis with no inference-system mechanism.

records.title: HAWAII: Hierarchical Visual Knowledge Transfer for Efficient Vision-Language Models
records.reason: HAWAII distills multiple pretrained visual experts into a single vision encoder so VLMs gain expert strengths with minimal inference overhead; efficiency is a distillation side benefit for a vision capability goal, so borderline.

records.title: Multiformer: A Head-Configurable Transformer-Based Model for Direct Speech Translation
records.reason: Multiformer configures attention heads for direct speech translation to handle long redundant speech sequences with efficient attention variants; an application-specific speech architecture with an efficiency flavor, hence borderline.

records.title: idT5: Indonesian Version of Multilingual T5 Transformer
records.reason: idT5 fine-tunes multilingual T5 for Indonesian language coverage; a language-resource adaptation with no inference-system content.

records.title: Tree of Agents: Improving Long-Context Capabilities of Large Language Models through Multi-Perspective Reasoning
records.reason: Tree of Agents segments long inputs across chunk-processing agents to mitigate lost-in-the-middle in long-context LLM use; an inference-time reasoning framework, but its contribution is reasoning quality over chunks rather than serving or decoding efficiency, so borderline.

records.title: BioMamba: Domain-Adaptive Biomedical Language Models
records.reason: BioMamba continues pretraining Mamba2 checkpoints on PubMed-heavy mixtures for biomedical text; a domain-adapted language model with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Slow-Fast Architecture for Video Multi-Modal Large Language Models
records.reason: A slow-fast architecture allocates temporal resolution and spatial detail under a compute budget for video MLLMs; compute-aware model architecture for a video application rather than an inference system mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: TQCompressor: Improving Tensor Decomposition Methods in Neural Networks Via Permutations
records.reason: TQCompressor improves Kronecker tensor decomposition via permutations to compress GPT-2 with less expressivity loss; a generic model-compression study on a small legacy model, with limited evidence as an LLM inference contribution, hence borderline.

records.title: Speculative Reward Model Boosts Decision Making Ability of LLMs Cost-Effectively
records.reason: A speculative reward model accelerates LLM decision-making search by cheaply estimating rewards before full evaluation; speculation is applied to reward estimation for agent decisions, not token decoding, so the inference-system link is indirect and borderline.

records.title: Frequency-Informed Positional Encoding: An Enhanced Transformer for Vessel Trajectory Prediction
records.reason: Frequency-informed positional encoding improves transformer generalization for vessel trajectory prediction on AIS maritime data; a shipping-traffic application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Adaptation of Multilingual T5 Transformer for Indonesian Language
records.reason: This ITIS paper adapts multilingual T5 to Indonesian, duplicating the idT5 language-adaptation line of work; no inference-system content.

records.title: OctoSelector: Efficient and Effective Batch-Aware Model Selection for Large Language Models
records.reason: OctoSelector clusters queries by difficulty-aware representations and selects LLMs per batch under accuracy, latency and cost constraints; batch-aware model selection is serving-adjacent routing, but framed as a selection framework rather than a serving system, so borderline.

records.title: From Denoising to Refining: A Corrective Framework for Vision-Language Diffusion Model
records.reason: A corrective framework reframes vision-language diffusion generation from denoising to refining to stop error cascades in parallel decoding; decoding behavior of multimodal diffusion models, adjacent to but outside LLM inference systems, hence borderline.

records.title: Selecting Language Models for Social Science: Start Small, Start Open, and Validate
records.reason: This paper advises social scientists to start small and open when selecting among thousands of LLMs and to validate measures ex-post; usage guidance for a research community, not an inference contribution.

records.title: Revealing Behavioral Plasticity in Large Language Models: A Token-Conditional Perspective
records.reason: Token-conditional generation exposes behavioral plasticity, switching LLMs between reasoning and direct answering at inference time, stabilized by RL; the phenomenon is behavioral control, not an inference-system efficiency or serving mechanism.

records.title: Short Data, Long Context: Distilling Positional Knowledge in Transformers
records.reason: Long-context retrieval ability is distilled into students using only packed short-context samples via logit distillation and RoPE analysis; a training-side distillation recipe, with no inference-time mechanism, so unrelated under the training-only rule.

records.title: BYORn: Bootstrap Your Own Responses to Defend Large Vision-Language Models Against Backdoor Attacks
records.reason: BYORn detects semantically implausible poisoned responses to make supervised fine-tuning robust to backdoor attacks in vision-language models; a training-security defense with no inference contribution.

records.title: Interleaved Speech Language Models Latently Work In Text
records.reason: Probing shows interleaved speech-text language models pass through a latent transcription phase in intermediate layers; an interpretability analysis of speech LMs with no inference-system content.

records.title: PACE: A Playback-Aligned Context Engine for LLM-Based Full-Duplex Voice Dialogue
records.reason: PACE is provider-independent middleware that anchors the model-facing context of full-duplex voice services to the client playback boundary; a serving-layer context management idea for voice dialogue, but narrow and unvalidated as a general inference system, so borderline.

records.title: FlashBack: Knowing When to Remember in Streaming Vision-Language Models
records.reason: FlashBack decides when streaming vision-language models should retrieve historical memory under a bounded compute budget; memory-access gating for streaming VLM perception is inference-adjacent, but tied to a video application, hence borderline.

records.title: Rubric Judgments Lack Uncertainty: Conformal Weighting for LLM Evaluation
records.reason: Conformal weighting adds uncertainty estimates to rubric-based LLM-as-judge evaluation scores; an evaluation methodology paper with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: KnitTrans: Coordinated Trajectory Transfer for Effective and Efficient LLM Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: KnitTrans coordinates trajectory transfer from rollout to training in LLM RL, reducing staleness from disaggregated pipelining and redundant data movement; RL training-system efficiency where generation is a component, but the target is training throughput, so borderline.

records.title: DSDFormer: An Innovative Transformer-Mamba Framework for Robust High-Precision Driver Distraction Identification
records.reason: DSDFormer fuses transformer and Mamba features for driver distraction identification from vehicle imagery; an automotive safety application with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: Scaling Laws of Graph Neural Networks for Atomistic Materials Modeling*
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to scaling laws of graph neural networks for atomistic materials modeling, a materials-science application, with no inference-system subject in the title.

records.title: High-level Synthesis Directives Design Optimization via Large Language Model
records.reason: LLMs are used to optimize high-level synthesis directives for circuit design; an EDA application of LLMs as optimizers, with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Group Generalized Mean Pooling for Vision Transformer
records.reason: Group generalized mean pooling replaces class-token aggregation in vision transformers for image classification; a vision architecture detail with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: GuiLoMo: Allocating Expert Number and Rank for LoRA-MoE via Bilevel Optimization with GuidedSelection Vectors
records.reason: GuiLoMo allocates expert counts and LoRA ranks in LoRA-MoE fine-tuning via bilevel optimization; a parameter-efficient training method whose gains are in adaptation capacity, not inference execution.

records.title: Comparative study of state-based neural networks for virtual analog audio effects modeling
records.reason: Title explicitly limits the work to neural networks for virtual analog audio effects modeling, an audio-effects application, with no language-model inference subject in the title.

records.title: State-Space Large Audio Language Models
records.reason: State-space large audio language models replace quadratic transformer attention with SSMs to ease memory and time constraints in audio reasoning deployment; an alternative-architecture proposal for an audio application, with efficiency motivation but no LLM serving mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: UTF-8 Plumbing: Byte-level Tokenizers Unavoidably Enable LLMs to Generate Ill-formed UTF-8
records.reason: Byte-level tokenizers are shown to unavoidably let LLMs emit ill-formed UTF-8; a tokenization correctness analysis with no inference-system contribution.

records.title: Long-Range Transformer Architectures for Document Understanding
records.reason: Long-range transformer variants using local, hierarchical and recurrent attention are explored for multi-page document understanding; efficient-attention architectures demonstrated on a document application rather than LLM serving, hence borderline.

records.title: Balancing Information Accuracy and Response Timeliness in Networked LLMs
records.reason: A networked system aggregates outputs of smaller specialized language models, trading information accuracy against response timeliness; a deployment-level composition study without a concrete serving or decoding mechanism, so borderline.

records.title: HMVLM: Human Motion-Vision-Lanuage Model via MoE LoRA
records.reason: HMVLM integrates 3D human motion into language models via MoE LoRA instruction tuning; a multimodal capability model for motion understanding with no inference contribution.

records.title: Automated Multi-Language to English Machine Translation Using Generative Pre-Trained Transformers
records.reason: Sixteen open GPT models are benchmarked zero-shot for multilingual-to-English translation; an application benchmark study with no inference-system content.

records.title: Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Model for 3D Semantic Segmentation
records.reason: HybridTM combines transformer global attention with Mamba linear processing for 3D semantic segmentation of point clouds; a 3D vision architecture with no LLM inference relevance.

records.title: RoSearch: Search for Robust Student Architectures When Distilling Pre-trained Language Models
records.reason: RoSearch searches distilled student architectures that resist adversarial attacks when compressing pretrained language models; compression is via distillation architecture search with a robustness objective and training-time cost, so the inference contribution is indirect and borderline.

records.title: Cat, Rat, Meow: On the Alignment of Language Model and Human Term-Similarity Judgments
records.reason: Thirty-two language models are compared with human term-similarity judgments at behavioral and representational levels; a cognitive alignment evaluation with no inference-system content.
